purpose: P1/E5 attribution-only pass. Reuses all certified r1/r2 episodes and completed r2 attributions. Reruns attributions whose frozen-planner counterfactual outlived the original episode: beyond the last recorded decision tick the recorded planner holds its last plan (native no-new-plan path), counted per run.

engine_pin.instruction: Verify source/config hashes before launching a new batch; do not interpret this pin as historical LLM or bitwise trajectory equivalence.

stop_rule.note: After the target is met, seeds already started are completed; no new seed starts. Selection is the first N failures in seed order.

label_rule.definition: dP=V(rule-rl)-V0, dE=V(frozen LLM goals + GOAI rule executor)-V0, dI=V(rule)-V(rule-rl)-V(frozen+GOAI)+V0; label = largest of dP, dE, |dI|; balanced if top two within tie_margin; undetermined if largest < min_effect

limits: Reference components are archived baselines, not certified oracles
